|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Twice per game during opponent’s turn, may place three cards from hand on your Force Pile to draw top two cards from Reserve Deck.

See [[Captain Piett (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Original)|Original]] for the earlier wording. Both editions let Piett place three hand cards in his Force Pile to draw two Reserve Deck cards, twice per game during the opponent’s turn. The later slip says top two explicitly.
